notes.title: [RMAsia] Demo Version of "The Hearts of Immortality," a Tribute to Classic RPGs, Has Been Released
notes.notes:
[code]
Follow RMAsia Connoisseurs
[/code]

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/5b3b6386668809b4a9f26ac8e8773717ad8e14d6.jpg
After two years of dedicated work, as a tribute to classic long-form fantasy RPGs, The Hearts of Immortality is finally ready for Early Access!

This game blends both narrative and combat elements, and you'll find plenty of the creator's hardcore nerd style throughout, including a wide variety of selectable classes and the player-driven dialogue choices.
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/ccc79d063fc700d41ac5de90cf2513e376d6ee78.png

You can check out the DEMO version here, which includes the prologue and Act 1, "The Butcher of Laughmouth":
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3433660/Demo/
Download and try it out if you're interested – give it a go!

If you enjoy the demo, please add it to your wishlist – pretty please, pretty please~ ːsteamthumbsupː
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3431480/

notes.title: Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor Delayed Release
notes.notes:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33644753/9268e204b974b5aa9db85827ca7b8da090f44418.png

We apologize for disappointing those who were looking forward to Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor. After careful consideration, we have decided to delay the release of this game in order to achieve the quality we are striving for.

Originally, we planned to develop Peacemaker: Glorious Princess and Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor in parallel and release the former in May 2024 and the latter in September. Glorious Princess will be released on schedule, but our expectations for the quality of these two games are much higher than we originally thought. Therefore, we have decided to develop Bloody Emperor steadily rather than in a rush.

Finally, we apologize again, but we also promise to make Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor the best it can be.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1977070/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2548910/
